title: Twitch Affiliate Anniversary rmk2003 stream: need ideas for rewards!

posts.author: TheAnimationVoice
posts.body:
Wasn't sure where to post this, so please move if necessary.
I'm having my 2 year Twitch Affiliate anniversary stream on Tuesday. I'll be streaming rpg maker 2003 as I flesh out parts of the map/towns/castle I'm currently working on. I'd like to have rewards for certain amounts of subs/bits, but am not sure what amounts would be appropriate. Here's what I'm thinking:
1 sub/gift sub = become an npc
5 gift subs = become an npc AND name one of the locations (3 towns, 1 castle, 1 cave, 2 towers, 1 optional dungeon are what I have available)
10 gift subs = become a BOSS (available: cave boss, boss in each tower, boss in optional dungeon)
100 bits: create an item or enemy squad
500 bits: create a weapon or special ability
Does this sound like a reasonable reward tier? Would love to hear your input!!!
